name: Matterhorn
description: The pyramid peak above Zermatt is Switzerland’s most recognisable mountain. Trails and lifts ring its base.

name: Chillon Castle
description: A lakeside fortress on Lake Geneva shores near Montreux, with courtyards open to visitors.

name: Grossmünster
description: Twin towers of Zurich’s Romanesque church mark the old town above the Limmat.

name: Federal Palace
description: Switzerland’s parliament building faces the Bundesplatz with a green dome.

name: Kapellbrücke
description: A covered wooden bridge with a water tower spans the Reuss in Lucerne’s centre.

name: Jungfraujoch
description: A railway climbs to a high Alpine saddle with ice viewpoints between Jungfrau and Mönch.

name: Rhine Falls
description: Europe’s most powerful waterfall by volume thunders beside boat landings and cliff paths.

name: Lake Geneva promenade
description: The Jet d’Eau and lakeside parks define Geneva’s waterfront walks.

name: Interlaken
description: A resort town between lakes Thun and Brienz, gateway to Jungfrau region trails.

name: Swiss National Park
description: Alpine valleys with marked trails and wildlife viewing in Graubünden.

name: Markthalle Im Viadukt
description: Food vendors fill arches under a stone railway viaduct west of Zurich’s centre.

name: Bern farmers’ market
description: Outdoor market stalls fill Waisenhausplatz and nearby streets on market mornings.

name: Lausanne market days
description: Riponne and surrounding squares host produce and regional products.

name: Marktplatz Basel
description: Basel’s central market square holds produce stalls beneath the Rathaus façade.

name: Halles de Rive
description: A covered market and food shops near Lake Geneva’s left bank.

name: Montreux Jazz Festival
description: A lakeside summer music festival with stages along Lake Geneva since 1967.
